region change: apply exits 4, prints the ! immutable line and Apply refused ... nothing was changed, zero writes
apply --target bucket/C/B with a blocked sibling cluster writes only bucket, scope, collection
412 on PUT cluster is re-read and retried: 2 PUTs, exit 0
ApplyThenDrop on POST bucket: one POST, created despite the lost response; using it
injected 409 after the bucket was created: already exists; using it, exit 0
two 412s on PUT cluster: exit 1, changed concurrently; re-run plan
real apply -o json: status ok, every action done, connectionStrings for the new cluster

new problem under This change is not valid, then the old one under Already in capella.yaml before this command
cluster create with an overlapping CIDR: This change is not valid, so nothing was changed; file and Capella untouched
wizard: dev size + --availability multi is explained and provider and size are asked again, name kept
cluster POST 422: exit 1, Capella message and the action line
validate on a bad hibernation field names guide hibernation, which exists
validate prints each warning with location and fix command; plan prints only the count
warnings on validate/plan, none on cidr list, cluster get, project list
seeded Capella: scale-out diff line, + bucket summary, = scope and the Plan: summary line
--detailed-exitcode: 0 clean, 2 changes, 4 blocked (region change)

seeded cluster: magma bucket, scope, maxTTL -1 collection and schedule lines; nothing deferred
plan --target bucket/C/B prints only that bucket line
--on sends turnOnLinkedAppService false, --with-app-service true
--on while turningOff waits for turnedOff then sends one POST
--off while turningOff waits and sends no request
409 on power re-reads and retries once; a second 409 exits 1 with an action
turningOnFailed exits 1 naming the state and the activity log
power --off notes when the active schedule turns the cluster on; no note when paused

declarative commands at --log-level debug incl. a retried 503 GET never print the API key or canary
panic carrying the API key and canary is recovered by cli.Run, printed redacted (debug stack too), exit 1
plan + schedule summary line; apply one POST with all seven days and the timezone
one-line friday diff; PUT carries the full 7-day body and If-Match
ensure: absent with no Capella schedule: no change, zero writes
schedule omitted from the file is left in Capella, zero writes
turned-off cluster: schedule planned (0 blocked) and created
managed delete removes the Capella schedule, marks ensure: absent; sync drops it; second sync in sync (cbctl keeps a marker until sync)
applied managed set records hibernation incl. friday, one POST, sync already in sync
grid rows and clock-driven Next: line; JSON nextTransition state and time
paused: true: POST schedule then DELETE activationState, paused in Capella, then clean
cluster delete: dots on a terminal only, deleted (Ns) total time

unknown path suggests the correctly cased clusters.buckets.storageBackend

capella --help lists every command group
